reason: Expert shares a known issue where firmware upgrade 1.4 disables ATPC on microwave links, and gives the troubleshooting rule to check and enable it.

knowledge.summary: The 1.4 firmware upgrade disables ATPC on microwave links, causing link fading in rain; check and re-enable ATPC after upgrading.
knowledge.author: Jari Jänne
knowledge.details: Firmware 1.4 resets ATPC setting to off.
